Asana to Ziffr

1. Fill in the Settings node: your Ziffr address, the Webhook's id and secret, and the id of the Asana project.
2. Add the Asana credential to the List tasks node.
3. Activate the workflow. Every 5 minutes it tells Ziffr which tasks were completed or reopened, and passes on a line starting "Reply:" in a task's description.

Self-hosted n8n: set NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=crypto. Details: docs/automations/asana.md
